initiatives.name: Net Zero Emissions & Decarbonisation Roadmap
initiatives.summary: Endeavour implemented a comprehensive Tyre Management Programme at Houndé using specialised maintenance equipment and real-time monitoring to reduce tyre replacement needs, cutting costs and emissions. The programme has generated $764,000 in cost avoidance and reduced emissions by 1.59kt CO2e since 2021.

evidence.title: Net Zero Scope 1&2 by 2050, 30% intensity cut by 2030
evidence.summary: Endeavour has set a goal of Net Zero Scope 1 and 2 emissions by 2050 and a medium-term target to reduce Scope 1 and 2 GHG emissions intensity by 30% by 2030 from a 2022 baseline. Progress in 2025 included emissions intensity reduction to 572 kgCO2e/oz Au and 37% renewable electricity in the mix.
evidence.quote: We have a goal of Net Zero Scope 1 and 2 emissions by 2050 and have set a target to reduce our Scope 1 and 2 greenhouse gas emissions intensity by 30% by 2030 (from a 2022 baseline) to drive decisive action across our operations.

evidence.title: Solar power plant investment at Sabodala-Massawa
evidence.summary: Endeavour installed a 37 MWp solar photovoltaic plant at its Sabodala-Massawa mine, demonstrating lower operating costs via cheaper solar power as part of its decarbonisation strategy to reduce diesel reliance and fuel cost volatility.
evidence.quote: Opportunities, like the installation of a 37 MWp solar photovoltaic plant at our Sabodala-Massawa mine, are already demonstrating lower operating costs via cheaper solar power.

evidence.title: Schneider Electric partnership for supplier decarbonisation
evidence.summary: Endeavour established a strategic partnership with Schneider Electric to provide suppliers with access to decarbonisation resources including educational webinars and advisory support, as part of its Sustainable Suppliers Programme targeting Scope 3 emissions reduction.
evidence.quote: We established a strategic partnership with Schneider Electric to provide our suppliers with access to decarbonisation resources, including educational webinars and advisory support.

evidence.title: Tyre management programme reduces emissions and costs
evidence.summary: Endeavour implemented a comprehensive Tyre Management Programme at Houndé using specialised maintenance equipment and real-time monitoring to reduce tyre replacement needs, cutting costs and emissions. The programme has generated $764,000 in cost avoidance and reduced emissions by 1.59kt CO2e since 2021.
evidence.quote: The programme's outcomes – Achieved a total reduction of 1.59kt CO2e since 2021, reducing Scope 1 annual emissions by 0.5%–0.7%. – Generated $764,000 in total cost avoidance since 2021.

initiatives.name: Assafou Tier 1 Project Development & Financing
initiatives.summary: Endeavour announced a new Shareholder Returns Programme committing to return at least $1.0 billion to shareholders over 2026-2028, contingent on gold price remaining at/above $3,000/oz and leverage staying below 0.5x net debt/EBITDA. This follows $1.6 billion already returned since 2021.

evidence.title: New $1.0 billion shareholder returns programme 2026-2028
evidence.summary: Endeavour announced a new Shareholder Returns Programme committing to return at least $1.0 billion to shareholders over 2026-2028, contingent on gold price remaining at/above $3,000/oz and leverage staying below 0.5x net debt/EBITDA. This follows $1.6 billion already returned since 2021.
evidence.quote: We will significantly increase minimum shareholder returns over the 2026 to 2028 period, as we simultaneously build Assafou, returning at least $1.0 billion provided the gold price remains at or above $3,000 per ounce, and the Company's leverage remains below its long-term target of 0.5x net debt / Adjusted EBITDA.

evidence.title: Assafou tier 1 project construction starting 2026
evidence.summary: Endeavour is advancing its next major growth project, Assafou, with construction targeted to begin in 2026 following completion of the Definitive Feasibility Study. The project is expected to produce an average of 329koz per year over its first 10 years at sector-leading low costs.
evidence.quote: The next tier 1 project, Assafou, is targeted to begin construction in 2026.

evidence.title: New $500 million senior note refinancing programme
evidence.summary: The Group announced a new $500 million senior note programme during the year to refinance the previous programme, giving strategic flexibility and capacity for organic and external growth opportunities including the Assafou construction phase.
evidence.quote: The Group also announced a new $500 million senior note programme during the year to refinance the previous programme.

initiatives.name: Bantou & Nabanga Property Relinquishment
initiatives.summary: Endeavour recognized impairment charges totaling over $190 million in 2025, including $139.7 million for Bantou and $31.8 million for Nabanga properties in Burkina Faso, as these were deemed no longer aligned with current exploration strategy, alongside intent to relinquish certain exploration permits.

evidence.title: Impairment and relinquishment of Bantou, Nabanga exploration properties
evidence.summary: Endeavour recognized impairment charges totaling over $190 million in 2025, including $139.7 million for Bantou and $31.8 million for Nabanga properties in Burkina Faso, as these were deemed no longer aligned with current exploration strategy, alongside intent to relinquish certain exploration permits.
evidence.quote: The charge in 2025 comprised predominantly exploration and evaluation properties that included $139.7 million and $31.8 million in relation to the Bantou and Nabanga properties in Burkina Faso, respectively, where the Group has deemed that the development of these properties is no longer aligned with the current exploration strategy.

initiatives.name: West Africa Local Content & Community Development
initiatives.summary: Endeavour launched the Local Content Accelerator programme across West Africa with strategic partner EFEDCOM (ECOWAS Federation of Chambers of Mines) to strengthen the regional mining supply chain, build local supplier competitiveness and improve access to finance. Forty-five suppliers completed capacity-building sessions in 2025.

evidence.title: Local Content Accelerator programme with EFEDCOM

evidence.quote: In 2025, we launched the Local Content Accelerator programme across West Africa with strategic partner, the ECOWAS Federation of Chambers of Mines ("EFEDCOM") to strengthen the regional mining supply chain.

initiatives.name: Board Governance & Leadership Succession
initiatives.summary: Alison Henwood was appointed as an Independent Non-Executive Director effective January 2026, bringing extensive extractive industries and finance experience, following an external search by Korn Ferry. This coincides with Livia Mahler stepping down after nine years on the Board.

evidence.title: New Independent Non-Executive Director appointed
evidence.summary: Alison Henwood was appointed as an Independent Non-Executive Director effective January 2026, bringing extensive extractive industries and finance experience, following an external search by Korn Ferry. This coincides with Livia Mahler stepping down after nine years on the Board.
evidence.quote: We are pleased to welcome Alison Henwood who was appointed as an Independent Non-Executive Director effective 13 January 2026.

evidence.title: Board committee chair successions announced
evidence.summary: Following Livia Mahler's departure, Cathia Lawson-Hall will become Remuneration Committee Chair and Sakhila Mirza will step up to ESG Committee Chair, as part of planned Board succession.
evidence.quote: Cathia Lawson-Hall will step into the Remuneration Committee Chair role, having been on the Remuneration Committee at Endeavour since her appointment in 2023. Sakhila Mirza will then step up to the position of ESG Committee Chair.

initiatives.name: Women at Endeavour Leadership Development
initiatives.summary: Endeavour launched 'Empower' initiatives under its 'Women at Endeavour' programme and the LeadHer leadership programme with 15 participants to grow its female talent pipeline, having already achieved a 30% increase in women in management roles since 2021.

evidence.title: Women at Endeavour leadership programmes launched
evidence.summary: Endeavour launched 'Empower' initiatives under its 'Women at Endeavour' programme and the LeadHer leadership programme with 15 participants to grow its female talent pipeline, having already achieved a 30% increase in women in management roles since 2021.
evidence.quote: We launched the LeadHer programme with 15 participants to strengthen leadership skills... we are committed to growing our female talent pipeline through the 'Women at Endeavour' programme's 'Empower' initiatives which began during the year.

initiatives.name: AI-Enhanced Exploration Target Generation
initiatives.summary: Endeavour is applying a proprietary gold mineral system framework combined with AI to filter over 80 exploration targets and enhance target generation and prioritisation for its mineral resource discovery programme. This supports the Group's 12-15Moz discovery target between 2026-2030.

evidence.title: AI-enhanced exploration target generation framework

This supports the Group's 12-15Moz discovery target between 2026-2030.
evidence.quote: Over 80 exploration targets to be filtered through a proprietary gold mineral system framework applied to delineate tier 1 opportunities along with AI to enhance target generation and prioritisation.

initiatives.name: Group Security Operations Centralisation
initiatives.summary: Endeavour plans to deploy a centralised Group Security Operations Command Centre (SOC) in Abidjan and develop a unified Group Security Management System to strengthen proactive risk anticipation across its West African operations.

evidence.title: Deployment of centralised 24/7 Group Security Operations Command Centre

evidence.quote: Deploy a centralised 24/7 Group Security Operations Command Centre ("SOC") in Abidjan.

initiatives.name: New Ventures Exploration Diversification
initiatives.summary: Endeavour is establishing a New Ventures strategy focused on expanding and diversifying its exploration footprint into highly prospective, immature gold provinces beyond West Africa, leveraging early-stage exploration companies with in-country and technical expertise, to address concentration risk.
